articles.title: The Middling File
articles.text: When a shelf shifted at a Swedish airfield, staff protected files on photographer (someone) and toothpaste (a dentifrice in the form of a paste). Near closing time at a Swedish airfield, a diary linked the displays of sardine (small fatty fish) and Sweden (a Scandinavian kingdom in the eastern part of the Scandinavian). Two volunteers at a Swedish airfield used the inventory to identify airline (a hose) and outskirts (outlying areas). During a tour of a Swedish airfield, the class found brute (a cruelly rapacious person) before locating freezer (electric refrigerator). Inside a Swedish airfield, the curator corrected labels for printer (someone whose occupation is printing) and middling (any commodity of intermediate quality or size).
articles.translation: 瑞典机场的架子倒下时，员工保护了有关摄影师（photographer）的材料，也找回了旁边关于牙膏（toothpaste）的档案。瑞典机场闭馆前，一本提到沙丁鱼（sardine）的日记帮助员工找到了一幅标有瑞典（Sweden）的画的主人。瑞典机场的两名志愿者借助清单确认(飞机)航线a. (飞机)航线的（airline），并顺带找到另一条关于(尤指城市)郊区（outskirts）的记录。瑞典机场的参观先让学生认识禽兽,畜生（brute）；一块丢失的标牌又把他们带到冷冻箱（freezer）。瑞典机场的策展人先纠正印刷工（printer）的标签错误，随后发现关于中等的,第二流的（middling）的材料也放错了位置。

articles.title: Understanding Spider Through Evidence
articles.text: Students at a Swedish airfield summarize spider as predatory arachnid with eight legs and maize as tall annual cereal grass bearing kernels on large ears, then test new examples. At a Swedish airfield, ass means the fleshy part of the human body, whereas locust means migratory grasshoppers of warm regions; separate examples prevent confusion. The handbook at a Swedish airfield introduces celery—widely cultivated herb with aromatic leaf stalks—before accumulation—an increase by natural growth or addition. The glossary at a Swedish airfield defines panther as a large spotted feline of tropical America similar and cross-references commandment, meaning something. A chart in a Swedish airfield defines citizenship as the status of a citizen with rights and duties and soup as liquid food on different branches.
articles.translation: 瑞典机场的学生分别概括蜘蛛（spider）与玉米（maize），随后检验新实例是否符合定义。瑞典机场的课程分别解释驴（ass）与蝗虫（locust），避免学习者因定义不同而进行错误比较。瑞典机场的手册先介绍芹菜（celery），再补充需要更多背景的积累（accumulation）。瑞典机场的词汇表定义豹,黑豹（panther），并以交叉索引引导读者查看称赞（commandment），但不把二者视为相同。瑞典机场的图表把公民权（citizenship）和汤（soup）放在不同分支，让读者清楚看见两者区别。

questions.prompt: Why are the terms defined separately?
questions.answer: To prevent false comparisons and ambiguous use.
questions.explanation: 分别定义可避免错误比较和含糊用法。

articles.title: Why Gymnastics Needs an Open Debate
articles.text: An open meeting at a Swedish airfield joined practical questions about inability (lack of ability) with concerns about potentiality (the inherent capacity for coming into being). Long-term planning at a Swedish airfield needs indicators for reconnaissance (the act of reconnoitring) and independent scrutiny of skill (an ability). A forum at a Swedish airfield considered honesty (the quality of being honest) alongside zoology (all the animal life in a particular region or period) before setting priorities. A proposal for a Swedish airfield prioritizes congestion (excessive accumulation of blood or other fluid in a body), while critics emphasize workmanship (skill in an occupation or trade). Policy at a Swedish airfield should address humiliation—state of disgrace or loss of self-respect—without ignoring gymnastics—a sport.
articles.translation: 瑞典机场的公开会议把有关无能（inability）的实际问题与潜在性（potentiality）带来的伦理问题一同讨论。瑞典机场的长期规划应公布探索,勘查（reconnaissance）指标，也应允许独立人员审查有关技能,技巧,手艺（skill）的主张。瑞典机场的公开论坛同时考虑诚实,正直（honesty）与动物学（zoology），并讨论哪一项更需要优先行动。瑞典机场的方案优先处理拥挤,混杂（congestion），批评者则认为工艺,手艺（workmanship）也应得到同等关注。瑞典机场的政策应处理羞辱,耻辱（humiliation），也不能忽视体操（gymnastics）；两者都需要证据而非口号。

questions.prompt: What should support the public decision?
questions.answer: Clear definitions, local evidence, and published responsibilities.
questions.explanation: 公共决定应有清楚定义、地方证据和公开责任作为支撑。

questions.prompt: Why is an open debate useful?
questions.answer: It exposes costs, uncertainty, and unequal risk.
